Add a censoring-marks layer

Source: R/er-tte-add.R
er_tte_add_censor.Rd

Adds the censor layer: a tick mark at every time a subject was censored, read from the fit already stored on object$km (see er_tte()) – no recomputation happens here. Singleton (a second call replaces the previous one).

Usage

er_tte_add_censor(object, style = NULL, ...)

Arguments

object

Partially constructed plot (has S3 class er_tte).

style

Function drawing the censoring marks. Defaults to er_style_tte_censor_ticks().

...

Additional named arguments forwarded unchanged to style at build time (e.g. er_style_tte_censor_ticks()'s shape/ size/stroke).

Value

The input object, with the censor layer added.

See also

er_tte(), er_style_tte_censor_ticks()

Examples

library(survival)
lung |>
  er_tte(time, status == 2) |>
  er_tte_add_curve() |>
  er_tte_add_censor() |>
  plot()
